exposureDescription: I previously reviewed version1 author keys/solutions. Version2 key and revised solutions remain unopened at this save. This is independent re-derivation with prior-version exposure, not a first-time blind review.

answers.reasoning: For fixed aligned frames on one body, omega is common and v3-v2=omega cross p23. The reversed p23 cross omega gives the opposite offset velocity.
Lock joints, write link force and moment balance, then project the correctly transported effort on the joint axis. Force-only/revolute and moment-only/prismatic swaps do not match allowed motion.
Given the hand wrench, recursively transport force and moment toward the base, preserving accumulated lever-arm moments. Neither reversing propagation nor resetting the moment at every link is valid.
At theta2=90°, J3=[[2,0],[1,1]]. Its transpose times(3,4) gives(10,4). Direct J3 times F gives the repaired distractor(6,7); omitted first-link moment gives(4,4), sign flip gives(-2,4).
At theta2=0, sin theta2=0; with fy=0 both generalized torques vanish. This does not prove unbounded physical structural capacity.
The pure terminal z couple is invariant under every planar z rotation and is transmitted to both axes, adding M to both efforts.
J*qdot=(0.5,0.1); F dot v=1.9 W. Individual joint powers are0.6,-0.8,2.1. Omitting joint1 gives1.3, omitting joint2 gives2.7, reversing joint2 contribution gives3.5.
The strike assumes no relative angular motion of the two body-fixed frames; absolute body angular motion may remain and coincident origins alone do not remove relative rotation.
vB in A=vA+omega cross p=vA-[p]cross*omega. Both terms rotate to B, giving upper-right -R[p]cross. Moving R to the right while retaining p in A mixes coordinate bases.
p is now explicitly in A. omega cross p=(0,2,0), add vA to get(1,2,0), then Rz(-90) gives(2,-1,0).
p is explicitly in A. Rotate FB=(2,0,0) by+90° to FA=(0,2,0), rotate NB unchanged, and add p cross FA=(0,0,2), giving NA=(0,0,5).

With common origin p=0, off-diagonal cross-product blocks vanish. Both linear/angular components and force/moment components must rotate into their common output basis with direction-appropriate rotations.
Source p349 states outward base-to-tip velocity recursion, and the added p340 states known hand force/moment propagates toward base. The two different boundary data determine the two directions.
